about: The last release of each surface that has been SURVEYED. Not the latest release that exists - the latest one a human has actually read. The gap between the two is the work. Written by askit-capability-whats-new, which PROPOSES this file and never writes it; a human lands it alongside the survey record so the pin and the reading move together.

conventions.surveyedThrough: A version string the vendor published, copied VERBATIM. Not normalised, not parsed into semver, not decorated - a reader must be able to search the vendor's own changelog for this exact string and find the entry the survey stopped at. A version rather than a date, because a date pin silently loses anything published out of order and gives two people different answers to the same question.
conventions.surveyedOn: When a human read it. A NOTE, never a gate: an old survey means work is waiting, not that a claim has expired. The mechanisms that DO block on age are the probe claims in foundation/claims/vendor-claims.json, where a probe's age is its whole verification. That asymmetry is deliberate.
conventions.by: A person. A survey is a reading, and readings have readers.
conventions.noFeed: A surface with no versioned release feed carries this instead of surveyedThrough, naming what tracks it instead.

claude-code.note: Feed confirmed reachable and versioned; entries carry a label plus a date, and the page is generated from CHANGELOG.md on GitHub.

cowork.note: Release notes for Claude Desktop, covering Cowork and Claude Code sessions. 31 entries in the window read.

codex.note: NOT YET PINNED. The changelog and GitHub releases were both confirmed to exist, but the version range was not read end to end in this pass - only the plugins documentation page was. Recorded as unpinned rather than guessed, so the next survey has an honest floor instead of a false one.

agentskills-io.noFeed: No versioned release feed. This surface is tracked by askit-standards-watch, which pins a git blob SHA-1 per artifact in foundation/claims/upstream-pin.json. Do not duplicate that pin here.
